Facility names in this batch include (by way of illustration, not exhaustive repetition of every field): 1GServers, 505 Marquette, Accelera Data Systems, Alembic Computer Services Inc, All About Serving Process Server, Allentown-TekPark, Alliance Technology, Arcola Tech Park, Argo Data Center, AZ Labs, Baltimore Technology Park, Cable & Wireless Cable Landing Station, Carrier Services Group, Datacenter, Data Center Lenexa, DataPro USA Web Development, Data Storage Centers, Digital West Data Center, Dynamics Mining, E-Foam, Emailage, ForceAmp.com, Geneseo Communications Inc, Insurance Exchange Building, Iron City No. 1 Power Generator and Compute Center, IT, J-Curve Technologies, K-Motion Interactive, Landmax Data Systems Inc, Live Oak Data Center, Marquette-Adams Telephone Coop, MDC, Menlo Digital MD-DC1, Minnesota Gateway Data Center, Newrays Two LLC Mining, OCOSA, Omnis Network, Open Data Centers Piscataway, OptimumHQ, Parsec Data Management, Pearl Plaza Office Building, Petadata, Precision Prints Lufkin Datacenter, Profit Finder Pro Software, QES Computers, Rack59 Data Center, Rad Web Hosting, Secure Data Center, Strategic Datasphere, Tennessee Processing Center LLC, The Chatfield Group, Thin-nology, VentureData, Vital Records, and Windbreak Cable.

Without a website, a distinguishing address, or any other lead in the source data, and with this registrys WebSearch tool exhausted for the duration of this project, attempting to attribute an operator to any of these names individually would require guessing at a real-world entity from a bare, often generic name (several, such as MDC, IT, and Datacenter, are single words or acronyms with no unique identifying value at all), which this registrys policy against matching entities on name alone and against fabricating unverified facts both prohibit. No operator attribution is made for any of these 55 facilities and none is fabricated; each remains an open research item that a future session with a working search tool, or manual human lookup, may be able to resolve.

reading.body:
VentureData in Rexburg, Idaho is mapped as a building at 19 College Avenue but its operator is not published and cannot be identified from available sources. No power capacity, IT load, cooling system, or certification details are available from the facility operator. Without published specifications, it is not possible to assess the campus's relevance to AI infrastructure scaling.

Idaho has two mapped data center facilities and neither has published power figures. VentureData would rank first among Idaho's published capacities if it reported any, but it does not. The state remains effectively invisible in the public record of AI-capable data center capacity.

This facility cannot be evaluated against the thesis that grid constraints bind AI scaling. Whether VentureData hosts AI workloads, what power density it sustains, or how it connects to Idaho's grid are unknown. Future identification of its operator and published specifications would determine whether Rexburg represents material capacity or remains a gap in the available data.
